statement: Pinned Wiiuse Linux backend uses BlueZ adapter discovery plus AF_BLUETOOTH L2CAP control and interrupt sockets to a Bluetooth device, and performs its native handshake after socket connection. The surveyed Linux backend does not open a hidraw or evdev path. Consequently current linux.uhid.bluetooth and linux.uinput realizations lack the radio/L2CAP endpoint required to connect; Windows HID implementations are separate and cannot be inferred from the Linux backend.
